notes: transparent_png contains cleaned raster extractions for use as app assets.
raw_crops contains the exact screenshot crops before background cleanup.
illustrations contains the two larger decorative artwork regions.
The screenshot is raster, so the pack contains PNGs rather than true source SVG vectors.
chevron_right_blue can be reused for Start your streak and all four Muhasaba row chevrons.
Status-bar icons are intentionally excluded because iOS/Android render those as system UI.
